description: A long, narrow, slightly meandering linear ridge (approx. 1.0 km in length by 8–12 m in width) visible in the hillshade/DTM as a low‐relief embankment or causeway. It exhibits consistent rectilinear alignment with subtle parallel edges and intermittent terrace‐like scarping. In the true‐color Sentinel‐2 image, it corresponds to a faint yellow‐green line—indicative of vegetation differences—while the NIR band shows reduced reflectance along the same trace, suggesting localized moisture retention or altered soil properties consistent with anthropogenic earthworks.
